title: Redcurrant Crumble
description: A sweet dessert made with fresh redcurrants and a crunchy oat topping. Perfect for a warm evening.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the redcurrants, granulated sugar, and flour.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x9-inch baking dish.
In a separate bowl, combine the rolled oats, brown sugar, and ground cinnamon.
Add the cold butter to the oat mixture and use your fingers or a pastry blender to work it into the dry ingredients until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Spread the crumb mixture evenly over the redcurrant mixture.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and the fruit is tender.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
